0022600136.text: The Magic (1-2) visit the Raptors (2-1) for their fourth game of the season, with Orlando 10th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Southeast, while Toronto sits 4th in the East and 0.5 games back in the Atlantic. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, and Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Magic lost 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
